tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.fertilizer: Balanced NPK early; higher K before fruiting. Calcium for blossom-end rot.
tomato.sowing: Transplant seedlings after last frost; 45-60 cm spacing.
tomato.irrigation: Drip 2-3x weekly; avoid leaf wetness. Increase at flowering/fruiting.
tomato.pest_care: Scout for hornworms, whiteflies, early blight. Stake and prune suckers.
tomato.harvest: 60-85 days after transplant; pick when fully colored.
tomato.storage: Cool 10-15C; avoid refrigeration for best flavor.

timeline.task: Start seeds indoors or buy transplants.
Harvest ripe fruit; remove diseased leaves.

potato.name: Potato
potato.fertilizer: Higher P at planting; moderate N; avoid excess N (lush foliage, small tubers).
potato.sowing: Plant seed tubers 10-15 cm deep after soil reaches 7C.
potato.irrigation: Uniform moisture during tuber formation; reduce before harvest.
potato.pest_care: Colorado beetle, late blight risk in humid weather; hill rows.
potato.storage: Cure 7-10 days at 15C then store cool, dark, humid.

timeline.task: Chit seed potatoes; plant in ridges.
Monitor late blight; reduce irrigation late.
Dig when skins set; dry before storage.

corn.name: Corn (Maize)
corn.fertilizer: Heavy nitrogen feeder; split N at planting and knee-high stage.
corn.sowing: Direct seed when soil >10C; 20-25 cm spacing in blocks for pollination.
corn.irrigation: Critical at silking/tasseling; 25-40 mm per week in dry periods.
corn.pest_care: Corn earworm, rust; rotate crops; scout lower leaves.
corn.storage: Dry to 14% moisture for grain; use fresh sweet corn quickly.

timeline.task: Plant in blocks; apply starter fertilizer.

pepper.name: Bell Pepper
pepper.fertilizer: Moderate N; increase Ca and K during fruit development.
pepper.sowing: Transplant after frost; warm soil essential.
pepper.irrigation: Drip irrigation; avoid overhead water to reduce bacterial spot.
pepper.pest_care: Aphids, bacterial spot; use mulch and crop rotation.
pepper.harvest: 60-90 days; pick when firm and full size.
pepper.storage: 10-12C with high humidity; do not chill below 7C.

timeline.task: Harden off seedlings; transplant to field.
Increase K; harvest regularly to encourage set.

apple.name: Apple
apple.fertilizer: Annual balanced fertilizer; boron and zinc if deficient.
apple.sowing: Plant bare-root trees in dormancy; proper spacing 4-6 m.
apple.irrigation: Deep watering young trees weekly in dry spells.
apple.pest_care: Scab, fire blight, codling moth; dormant sprays and sanitation.

timeline.task: Prune; apply dormant oil if needed.

rice.name: Rice
rice.fertilizer: Split N applications; Zn on deficient soils.
rice.sowing: Nursery then transplant, or direct seeded in paddies.
rice.irrigation: Maintain 5-10 cm standing water in vegetative stage; drain before harvest.
rice.pest_care: Stem borer, blast; resistant varieties and water management.
rice.storage: Dry to 14% moisture; protect from pests.

timeline.task: Drain field; combine or hand harvest.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.fertilizer: N at tillering and jointing; P at planting.
wheat.sowing: Drill seed 3-5 cm deep in moist soil.
wheat.irrigation: Supplement at critical growth if rainfall low.

soybean.name: Soybean
soybean.fertilizer: Inoculate rhizobia; moderate P and K.
soybean.irrigation: Most critical at flowering and pod fill.

timeline.task: Water stress avoidance at pod fill.

onion.name: Onion
onion.fertilizer: Moderate N early; reduce N at bulbing; adequate S.
onion.irrigation: Even moisture; reduce when tops fall over.
onion.pest_care: Thrips, downy mildew; avoid excessive nitrogen late.

timeline.task: Long days trigger bulbing in many varieties.
Pull when tops lodge; cure bulbs.

cucumber.name: Cucumber
cucumber.fertilizer: Light frequent N; K during fruiting.
cucumber.sowing: Direct seed or transplant after frost.
cucumber.irrigation: Daily drip in hot weather; mulch to conserve moisture.
cucumber.pest_care: Cucumber beetle, powdery mildew; trellis for airflow.
cucumber.harvest: 50-70 days; pick frequently for continued yield.

timeline.task: Train on trellis; scout beetles early.
